text:
Ana: quick sync — drafting an intake + feedback cadence for the private preview pilot. target: 8 customers across 2 waves, 6 weeks total. want ops + cs + research sanity check. primary goals: prompt coverage, latency signal, rollback criteria. anyone see major holes?

Kevin: split into two waves (4 then 4) so we can incorporate learnings. onboarding doc + tiny SDK sample should be ready before wave1 invites.

Maya: strongly +1 on 2 waves. need a UX checklist for first-run: key generation, quickstart in <30m, example prompts, streaming toggle. friction kills retention.

Jonah: filter for customers already on hosted inference or with strict latency SLAs — they surface perf problems quickly. also want a named technical contact per customer.

Lina: feedback plan: weekly 3-question pulse survey, biweekly 30-min interviews for first 4 weeks, automated telemetry snapshots (latency, errors), and a prompt sample repo for offline evals.

Ana: proposed recruitment filters: 1) production inference usage, 2) commit to ~1hr integration, 3) share ~100 sample prompts or dataset slice, 4) agree to fortnightly syncs and a short weekly pulse. edits?

Kevin: add: escalation contact and infra type (cloud / VPC). tag customers by model family and typical sequence lengths for rollout matrix.

Maya: draft onboarding note — pls critique:

"Hi! Thanks for joining Redwood private preview. Next steps: 1) register trial key (link), 2) run quickstart with SDK (<30m), 3) paste 50 sample prompts into shared doc, 4) opt into weekly pulse or biweekly interview. We'll sync in week2 to review latency & logs."

Jonah: add a production-safety checklist: data egress policy, KMS/HSM setup options, and an opt-out for request logging. legal needs that in writing.

Ana: will add opt-in/opt-out consent language. success criteria (draft): engagement: >=6/8 complete quickstart within 7 days; quality: <=2 customer-reported major regressions in pilot; latency: p95 <= 1.5x customer baseline for >=90% of requests; failure rate <0.5%; cost: per-token cost within +/-20% of modeled expectation after batching/quantization suggestions; rollout readiness: canary by model variant + automatic fallback.

Kevin: make p95 relative to each customer's baseline sequence distribution. track request failure rate metric.

Lina: add qualitative: average pulse NPS >=6/10 and at least 3 interviews reporting measurable improvement or acceptable tradeoffs.

Maya: scope guard: freeze major infra changes that affect perf during each wave unless change has explicit short rollback. isolates signals.

Ana: ops-bot, create instrumentation checklist for what we need from customers vs Redwood collection.

ops-bot: checklist created: token-level latency, per-request status codes, model variant id, KV-cache hit rate, observed batch sizes, cold-start count, anonymized sample prompts. sharing policy: aggregated telemetry only unless explicit opt-in.

Jonah: add sanitized sample error traces and alert when error rate >0.5% sustained for 10m.

ops-bot: added automated alert and sample trace requirement.

Ana: recruitment channels: AE/CS warm outreach, targeted product blog + invite form, and prior beta list. incentives: early pricing, 3 months dedicated credits, co-marketing opportunity, and small implementation stipend for deeper integrations.

Kevin: stipend good idea — helps cover eng time.

Maya: co-marketing ok but require explicit approval for case studies.

Lina: I'll draft interview guide questions: focus on where latency/cost blocks features, and tradeoff tolerance between quality and cost. will post EOD Thu.

Ana: ops runbook items: onboarding doc, rollback playbook (when to rollback and how), routing rules for single-tenant vs shared variants, and weekly review template. owners: Ana — runbook + rollback; Kevin — SDK sample & perf baseline script; Maya — onboarding UX copy & consent; Jonah — CS handoff & SLA comms; Lina — interview guide + pulse survey.

Kevin: I'll add streaming and non-streaming snippets and a one-command perf baseline script.

Maya: I'll publish onboarding copy and microsite checklist.

Jonah: prepping CS 30-day playbook and escalation matrix.

Lina: interview guide up by EOD Thu.

Ana: next steps — I'll draft the invite email + shortscreen form and week-by-week pilot schedule. meet Fri 11am to finalize wave1 invites. flag if you can't make it. :calendar: :thumbsup:

Kevin: +1 Fri 11 ok.

Maya: yes.

Jonah: will attend.

Lina: noted.

Ana: thanks all, I'll share doc shortly. end thread.
